name: CodeXGLUE
description: CodeXGLUE is a machine learning benchmark dataset for code intelligence, featuring 14 datasets across 10 code-related tasks covering code understanding and generation. Tasks include code clone detection, defect detection, code search, code summarization, code completion, code translation, and code repair across multiple programming languages.
evaluation_method: Task-specific: accuracy, F1, BLEU, CodeBLEU, edit similarity
general_score_metric: Task-dependent (BLEU for generation, accuracy/F1 for classification)
typical_sota_score: Varies by task; CodeBERT and CodeT5 established strong baselines
reputation: Comprehensive code intelligence benchmark from Microsoft Research; widely used for evaluating code models; covers diverse programming languages and task types
notes: Published as NeurIPS 2021 Datasets and Benchmarks track paper. 14 datasets from public sources covering four categories: code-code (clone, defect, completion, repair, translation), text-code (search, generation), code-text (summarization), and text-text (doc translation). Served as the main benchmark for CodeBERT, GraphCodeBERT, and CodeT5 evaluations.
